definition: Translated is an Italian language technology and localization company headquartered in Rome.
details: Founded in 1999 by Marco Trombetti and Isabelle Andrieu, the company develops machine translation, multilingual AI, and localization technologies combining automated translation with human revision. Its platforms support context-aware localization and AI-assisted translation workflows.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Translated (company) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
